title: Byline immutable public build snapshot v3
description: Snapshot v2's native published content plus Byline Data: published Data Projects and the descriptors of the immutable, content-addressed Data Releases they use (never row data). Runtime validation checks publication revision, dataset counts, cross-record relationships, registered presentations and binding compatibility.

frontPage.description: Active Front Page placements: slot id to published Story id, applied by the canonical homepage resolver. Absent when the homepage is automatic.

articleBody.description: The semantic ArticleBody from @byline/article-body. Its exhaustive registry and runtime validator define the fields of each node variant.

mediaManifest.description: Immutable publication Media recipe output. The runtime validator also checks digest-derived paths, file sizes, responsive ladders and crop geometry.
